verdict.rationale: SSO and SAML access control is a fair question for a SaaS work-management platform, so this axis applies, but the evidence pack never mentions SSO, SAML, or identity-provider login. The closest items are adjacent: SOC 2/ISO 27001 hosting certifications, per-agent board-access scoping, and an Active Directory mention framed around support tickets. None of these show organization sign-in via SSO/SAML.

support.subject: As an engineer, I can secure organization access with SSO and SAML
